summary: Construction and improvement of real property is not taxed to the owner in Pennsylvania; the contractor pays tax on the materials it installs.

summary: Everyday clothing and footwear are exempt without a price limit; formal wear, costumes, fur articles and sports-only apparel are taxable.

conditions.when: formal day or evening apparel, costumes or ornamental wear
fur on the hide or pelt, imitation fur, or mixed-material fur articles where fur is more than three times the value of the next most valuable material
sporting apparel not normally worn except during sports, including athletic team uniforms and bathing suits

citations.title: 61 Pa. Code § 53.1(b)(2)
citations.quote: The sale or use of accessories, ornamental wear, formal day or evening apparel, fur articles and sporting goods and sporting clothing shall be subject to tax unless the purchaser is entitled to claim an exemption under the law.

citations.title: 61 Pa. Code § 53.2(a)

summary: Packaged liquor-store purchases, distributor/brewer beer sales and wine-to-go are taxable; beer sold by licensed retail dispensers is exempt.

wine sold to go by a Wine Expanded Permit holder
beer sold by a retail dispenser or liquor licensee rather than a brewer or distributor
